0022600024.text: Phoenix hosts Denver in the Suns' fourth game of the 2026-27 season and an Emirates NBA Cup West Group A matchup. The Suns are 1-2 (1-0 at home, 0-2 on the road) after a loss, sitting 3rd in the Pacific, 1.5 games back, and 11th in the West, while the Nuggets are 2-2 after a win, 4th in the Northwest, 2 games back, and 8th in the West. Phoenix is without Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery), and Oso Ighodaro is day-to-day with an oblique strain and a game-time decision. Denver is without Alpha Diallo (out, personal), Cameron Johnson (out, ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (out, knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (out, hamstring). The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Suns lost all three meetings, most recently a 125-123 loss in Phoenix on March 24, 2026.
